content:
{'translation': "With Apple's biggest product launch of the year — the September iPhone event — just one month away, here's what's expected to debut based on the various rumors.", 'has_been_translated': True}

{'translation': 'iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max and iPhone Ultra', 'has_been_translated': True}

{'translation': "This year's flagship iPhone lineup is reportedly set to be the smallest in years — and the most expensive.", 'has_been_translated': True}

{'translation': "That's because multiple signs indicate the standard iPhone 18 won't arrive until early 2027, and the iPhone Air 2 is also expected to be delayed alongside it.", 'has_been_translated': True}

{'translation': 'As a result, three new iPhones are expected next month:', 'has_been_translated': True}

  • {'translation': 'iPhone 18 Pro: Major camera upgrades, new colors, a smaller Dynamic Island, and more', 'has_been_translated': True}
  • {'translation': 'iPhone 18 Pro Max: All of the above, plus a bigger battery', 'has_been_translated': True}
  • {'translation': 'iPhone Ultra: A brand new design, and the first foldable iPhone', 'has_been_translated': True}

{'translation': 'Analysts estimate the iPhone 18 Pro will start at around $1,399, while the iPhone Ultra is expected to retail for around $1,999. Hopefully Apple can deliver pricing below expectations.', 'has_been_translated': True}

{'translation': 'Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12', 'has_been_translated': True}

{'translation': 'New Apple Watch models arrive every September, and this year is expected to be no different.', 'has_been_translated': True}

{'translation': 'Here are the two rumored new Apple Watch models:', 'has_been_translated': True}

  • {'translation': 'Apple Watch Ultra 4: New health sensors, a fresh new design, and more', 'has_been_translated': True}
  • {'translation': 'Apple Watch Series 12: More powerful SiP processor, new health features', 'has_been_translated': True}

{'translation': 'Details on both new watches remain pretty limited at this point. That could mean changes this year are relatively minor — or simply that Apple has plenty of surprises yet to reveal.', 'has_been_translated': True}

{'translation': 'Wild cards: New AirPods Pro, Apple home products', 'has_been_translated': True}

{'translation': 'The iPhone and Apple Watch are almost certain to appear at the September event, but Apple could also use the opportunity to launch other products.', 'has_been_translated': True}

{'translation': 'The most likely candidates are new AirPods and Apple home products.', 'has_been_translated': True}

  • {'translation': 'AirPods Pro with camera: Camera powers AI features, potentially health or accessibility uses too', 'has_been_translated': True}
  • {'translation': 'New Apple TV 4K: More powerful chip for Apple Intelligence and Siri AI', 'has_been_translated': True}
  • {'translation': 'HomePad/HomePod Touch: A HomePod with a screen, built around Siri', 'has_been_translated': True}
  • {'translation': 'HomePod mini 2: Siri AI support, new chip, improved sound', 'has_been_translated': True}
  • {'translation': 'HomePod 3: Siri AI support and a new chip, with otherwise relatively limited changes', 'has_been_translated': True}
  • {'translation': 'Apple security camera: A home monitoring camera with HomeKit Secure Video support', 'has_been_translated': True}

{'translation': 'Apple has plenty of other fall products that could appear next month as well, such as a new OLED iPad mini, new MacBook Pros, and Ultra models. However, these are widely expected to be pushed back to October.', 'has_been_translated': True}

{'translation': 'Which Apple product are you planning to pick up at the September event? Share your thoughts in the comments.', 'has_been_translated': True}

{'translation': 'Best iPhone accessories to buy', 'has_been_translated': True}

  • {'translation': 'AirPods Pro 3 (currently just $199, down from $249)', 'has_been_translated': True}
  • {'translation': 'iPhone MagSafe car mount', 'has_been_translated': True}
  • {'translation': 'AirTag 10-year battery case', 'has_been_translated': True}
  • {'translation': '100W USB-C fast charging power adapter', 'has_been_translated': True}
  • {'translation': 'AirTag 2 (single pack / four-pack)', 'has_been_translated': True}
